titles.title: Geriatrics Workforce Improvement Act
Geriatrics Workforce Improvement Act
A bill to amend the Public Health Service Act to reauthorize certain education and training programs relating to geriatrics, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions.
Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions. Hearings held.

committee.name: Senate Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions

bill.summary:
Geriatrics Workforce Improvement Act
This bill reauthorizes through FY2030 (1) the Geriatrics Workforce Enhancement Program, which provides grants to educate and train health professionals to care for older adults; and (2) the Geriatrics Academic Career Awards, which support the career development of junior faculty at health professions institutions who provide training in geriatrics. These programs are administered by the Health Resources and Services Administration.
